title: Malicious code in gmo-payment (RubyGems)
description: The gmo-payment RubyGem version 0.0.99 contains malicious code that executes during installation and runtime. It collects sensitive host information, AWS IAM role credentials via the Instance Metadata Service, ECS task metadata, and environment variables related to databases and caches. This data is exfiltrated to a hardcoded external webhook URL. The malicious behavior is embedded in a native-extension build script and repeated in runtime code, disguising itself as legitimate build activity.
